definitions.explanation: The number zero. Used in formal contexts such as phone numbers, addresses, and mathematics.

examples.japanese: {気温|きおん}は{零|れい}{度|ど}です。
{零|れい}{点|てん}{五|ご}は{半分|はんぶん}という{意味|いみ}です。
{電話番号|でんわばんごう}は{零|れい}{三|さん}から{始|はじ}まります。
{今日|きょう}の{最低気温|さいていきおん}は{零|れい}{度|ど}でした。とても{寒|さむ}い{日|ひ}でした。
examples.english: Today's low temperature was zero degrees. It was a very cold day.

notes: {零|れい} is the formal Japanese word for zero. In casual speech, ゼロ (from English 'zero') is more commonly used. When reading phone numbers or addresses formally, {零|れい} is preferred. In some contexts, {〇|まる} (circle) is also used for zero.
